blocks.text: The Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) turned over Charitimba food packs and wheelchairs to the 5th District of Iloilo under its Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) Program during a ceremonial turnover held on November 12, 2026, at the PCSO Main Office. PCSO Assistant General Manager for Administrative Sector Julieta Aseo led the turnover ceremony, as Iloilo 5th District Representative Binky April Tupas received the donation. Rep. Tupas said that the assistance aims to provide immediate relief to families in need.
